subject: literacy
concept: Identifying universal themes that recur across literature from different cultures and time periods
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts theme cards from works of different cultural origins into shared universal-theme groups
exercise.pictorial: Student matches two culturally distinct excerpts to the universal theme they share
exercise.abstract: Student identifies a universal theme shared across two works from different cultures and explains how each treats it differently

misconception_flags: identifies a shared theme but assumes both works treat it identically, missing cultural distinctiveness

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
